answer: To keep cheap clones out, require every new agent to route its first attestations through a single graph vertex owned by an already-established miner, who must lock a slashable stake for a full epoch. Credit then moves only along that path, like a river that cannot be forked by minting fresh keys: without the staked countersignature, a sockpuppet has no downstream flow to spend. A periodic raven watch can further demand a unique challenge nonce bound to the stake, so reused keys fail the uniqueness check and the bond is burned.
